doc: A float32 field with std 1.0e-15 (squares of 1e-30 stay normal float32, no denormal): still strictly positive, so the result has unit variance. A threshold of 1e-12 or 1e-9 instead of 0 would return values of order 1e-15. Default tolerance 1e-5/1e-6 (scale-free relative error, as the 1e-4 case).
